name: church
description: 은혜로운 예배 — 예배 준비와 로컬 송출
author: 은혜로운 예배

scripts.desktop:pack:win: npm run desktop:build-web && electron-builder --config desktop/builder.json --win portable --x64
scripts.desktop:pack:win:setup: npm run desktop:build-web && electron-builder --config desktop/builder.json --win nsis --x64
scripts.desktop:pack:mac: npm run desktop:build-web && electron-builder --config desktop/builder.json --mac dmg zip --x64 --arm64
scripts.desktop:pack:mac:current: npm run desktop:build-web && electron-builder --config desktop/builder.json --mac dmg zip
scripts.mobile:build-web: node scripts/check-desktop-env.mjs && node scripts/run-static-export.mjs && node scripts/ensure-capacitor-out.mjs
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run mobile:build-web && npx cap sync ios && node scripts/strip-capacitor-server-url.mjs && node scripts/inject-eunhye-app-id.mjs ios/App/App/public org.eunhye.worship.operator && node scripts/verify-capacitor-public.mjs operator
scripts.mobile:ios: npm run mobile:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.mobile:ios:sim: npm run mobile:sync && npx cap run ios --target "iPhone 17"
scripts.member:mobile:build-web: node scripts/check-desktop-env.mjs && node scripts/run-static-export.mjs && node scripts/ensure-capacitor-out.mjs
